topics.description: A man was shot and killed by federal agents in Minneapolis, sparking protests and calls for investigation. The incident has raised concerns about police brutality and the use of force by law enforcement.
An FBI agent resigned after trying to investigate an ICE officer who shot Renee Good. The agent claimed to have been pressured to drop the investigation.

China's top general has been placed under investigation as part of a military purge. This move is seen as a significant development in China's efforts to crack down on corruption and misconduct within its military.
